title: ddty’s Timber Tweaks
description: Ddty’s Timber Tweaks is a QoL woodcutting mod that lets you fell whole trees with a smooth bottom-to-top collapse, adds a short cooldown to prevent spam chopping, and triggers leaf decay after the tree fully breaks for a cleaner, more natural feel.
body:
**Ddty's Timber Tweaks is a woodcutting quality-of-life mod that lets you fell whole trees with a single chop — complete with a smooth collapse animation and natural cleanup!**

## Features
- **Tree Felling** — Sneak while chopping with an axe to fell an entire tree at once. Logs collapse from the bottom up with a satisfying animation.
  
- **Spam Protection** — A short cooldown between chops keeps tree felling balanced and prevents abuse.
  
- **Leaf Decay** — Leaves naturally decay after the tree fully falls, leaving no floating clusters behind.
  
- **Particle Effects** — Log breaking triggers visual particles for a more immersive chopping feel.
  
- **Configurable** — A config file lets you fine-tune break speed, and tree size limits to your liking.

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) Required
